note: Top-to-bottom order of the homepage sections, and the heading copy for each one. scripts/render-videos.cjs renders sections in exactly this order, so reordering the homepage means reordering this list and re-running the renderer. Card order inside a video section always follows data/bible-order.json.

sections.heading: Longer readings of the best-known passages.
sections.description: The famous Bible stories, in Bible order from Genesis to Revelation. Every card uses the video's public title and opens on YouTube.

sections.heading: Complete book readings, in Bible order.
sections.description: Every whole-book recording published so far. Each one has its own page with the full reading, a short summary, and chapter links.

sections.heading: Whole books, voice only, for sleep.
sections.description: After a short title card the screen stays black: just the voice reading every word, with no music. In Bible order, same as above.

sections.heading: Wear the words.
sections.description: A few Scripture-inspired pieces from our Printify shop, with the full line one click away. Purchases take place on Printify, not on this website.

sections.proposed: Proposed addition, pending Chris's approval. Delete this section from the list and re-run the renderer to remove it.
sections.heading: Keeping the Bible read aloud, free for everyone.
sections.description: Every reading on this site is free to listen to, and we would like to keep it that way for everyone. If these readings have been good to you, you can help cover the cost of recording more.
